designComparison.choice: Full per-operation draft index dictionaries, then reference swap
designComparison.coherence: Prepare every affected committed index draft and master state change under existing owner lock; any comparer fault discards drafts without comparator rollback. Publish all refs/Active/master/counters only after complete plan succeeds. Fulloperation planning must cover batch expiration+later lookup, not merely one RemoveEntry.
designComparison.advantages: Smallest conceptual/code correction with standard dictionaries; copyfastpath can avoid old-keyhash for exact samecustomcomparer. DirectAdd and secondary-fault factory commit can be strongly atomic.
designComparison.cost: O(sum affected live index entries) copied allocations/work per committed mutation; lazy no-draft for reads with no mutation. Bulk expiration/clear must prepare once per index, not clone onceperentry, otherwisequadratic. Live+draftexistence roughly doubles affected map backing storage transiently.
designComparison.remainingWork: Persistent originating pending cleanup still requires independent identity-safe removal or a separately qualified bounded contract. FullClear/Dispose must use no-comparer map Clear/swap and release all owned entries, rather than abort on per-keyremove. Do not claim complete factory/comparer package from committed drafts alone.
designComparison.assessment: Credible smallest bounded committed-state fix/reference design; preserve narrow claim and require actual allocation/cost acceptance before deploying wholesale to ARMmemory target.

designComparison.choice: Prepared publication slots in internal cached-hash buckets; identity removal
designComparison.coherence: One small internal typed map owner used for BOTH committed entries and pending creations. Outer Dictionary<int,bucket> uses builtinint keys. Bucket slots carry originalTKey,cachedhash,payload and stable identity handle. User GetHashCode/Equals occur only in lookup/preparation, not slot publication/removal or pendingcleanup.
designComparison.advantages: All perindex collision/key work completes before any logical publication; remove uses storedslot identity/hash, so persistently throwing secondary comparator cannot detach partial ownership. Pendingcleanup is identity-based too. Avoids full O(C*I) dictionary copies per operation and unboundedtombstones.
designComparison.cost: Additional slot/bucket references per retained key; ordinary mutation O(indexcount + collisionchains), worst-case O(C) percollisionbucket as with adversarialconstant hashes. More engineering than draftswap; keep utility internal, no novel publicpolicy.
designComparison.assessment: Preferred coherent GENERAL persistent-comparer safety design if Root chooses to include pending cleanup in this package. It is a prepared-state publication mechanism, not a requirement to redesign unrelatedcachepolicy. Full authored code and bounded cost/identity contracts need independent review before native execution.

Validate generation again after all user callbacks. No arbitrary user comparer call may remain after publish starts.
preferredPreparedSlotPlan.publication: Under same lock add stableintbucket/node links, entry Keys/handles, master long-id entry, Active state/counters/indexVersion and originating pending completion bookkeeping as one no-user-callback phase. DirectAdd resource ownership transfers only here; factoryfault before here disposes rejectedvalue exactly once.
preferredPreparedSlotPlan.removal: Use each entry cached stable slot to unlink by reference/index, remove empty intbucket with builtinint equality, then update master/Active/retiring/version together; no userhash/equality needed to retire, expire,evict,Clear orDispose. Public requested-key lookup can still throw before mutation, leaving old state owned/coherent.
preferredPreparedSlotPlan.pending: Pending creation stores a stable originindex slot/token. Success/fault/invalidation/cancel remove it by identity before completion+OwnershipReleased signals and release capacity; never call faulty originating keycomparer during cleanup. Late oldfactory cleanup must compare exact pending identity/generation and cannot remove a replacementslot for equalkey.
preferredPreparedSlotPlan.bulk: Prepare AddIndex entirely unpublished; publish entrymetadata only after all selector/comparer work succeeds and snapshotgenerationstillvalid. Clear/Dispose remove all owned committed/pending slots withoutkeycallbacks and preserve caller/retiring release obligations. No stale unpublished index metadata on existing entries after failedAddIndex.
preferredPreparedSlotPlan.releaseLists: Caller-local retired lists are owned even when later lookup/precheck faults. Deliver them through finally or prepare entire lockoperation before retiring, preserving original caller error. Disposal still completes actual resourcecleanup and retiring--/capacitysignal once.
preferredPreparedSlotPlan.costBounds: Committed+pending+retiring resource capacity remains unchanged. At most one live slot perindexperresource/pendingkey, no historicaldead slots. Remove emptybucket and clearpayload refs. New utility allocates pernewslot/necessarybucket growth, not everyexistingkey peroperation. Indexcount remains caller-configured/unboundedasbefore; do not infer hard byte/RSS cap.
preferredPreparedSlotPlan.limits: Stable key equality/hash semantics between successful operations remain collection prerequisite; armablethrowing comparer mayfail persistently but key-based lookup is then allowed tothrow. Guarantees are state/ownership and cleanup, not successful lookups with an unusable comparer. Arbitrary comparer-reentrant cache mutation, asynchronous fatal faults/OOM and malicious changinghash/equality need distinct contracts; no universalclaim.
